name: home-assistant
description: Query and control Home Assistant over REST. MCP stdio runs on the Grok Bot or Cursor computer, not on Home Assistant. HA_URL must be reachable from that computer.

HA_URL.title: Home Assistant URL
HA_URL.description: Base URL with no trailing slash, reachable from the Grok Bot or Cursor computer (MCP stdio runs there, not on Home Assistant). Best: Tailscale MagicDNS such as http://homeassistant:8123 (that computer must be on the tailnet). Also fine: Nabu Casa or another public HTTPS URL. LAN-only IPs (192.168.x, 10.x, 172.16-31.x) fail unless that computer is on the house LAN; Grok Bot cloud computers are not.

HA_TOKEN.title: Long-lived access token
HA_TOKEN.description: Create one in Home Assistant under Profile, Security, Long-lived access tokens.
